InternalTools._Comment: Super User, Cognito, and Feedback are available on non-Windows hosts and on the Windows hosts listed here.

Database._DevPasswordComment: Optional in-house dev convenience — set 'DevPassword' to the SA password if your team prefers to share it via committed appsettings rather than per-machine user-secrets. Activated by UNCHECKING 'Get DB Password from System Secrets' on the welcome screen. NEVER set this in appsettings.json files that ship to customers; production force-locks the toggle ON.

RptBridge._comment: File-drop folders watched by RptXmlBridge.exe (net48 x86, hosts Crystal). HomeFront writes .rpt to InboxPath; the bridge writes .xml + .done (or .err) to OutboxPath. Defaults below are used if any key is missing.

Licensing._CRMSeatsComment: VB6 read CRM seat counts from the .lic license file (HFApp.LicensedSeats("CRM")); 1 seat cap matches legacy single-seat license.
